production_gpu/table_main_results.csv reports each FR method at its OWN best config (best-of-36 selection). This audit never uses that table; it pairs at MATCHED config.
stage=stage1_seeds: only methods ['abf', 'fr_estimated'] -- fewer than two of {estimated,uniform,oracle}.
stage=stage2_omega: only methods ['abf', 'fr_estimated'] -- fewer than two of {estimated,uniform,oracle}.

stage=stage4_gamma: only methods ['abf', 'fr_estimated'] -- fewer than two of {estimated,uniform,oracle}.
sweep=='main' only.  sweep=='rate' (gamma in {1,5,15,30,50}) has ONLY abf + fr_estimated -> excluded (needs >=2 of {estimated,uniform,oracle}).
matched_oracle_uniform_summary.csv holds medians only; the per-seed fr_uniform / fr_oracle scalars exist ONLY as raw .npz under oracle_uniform_baseline/raw/main.

fr_uniform and fr_oracle do not depend on target_ema_rate by construction (q_uni is flat; q_orc = exp(-beta(F_ref-B))), and were run once at ema=0.005. The SAME 20 uniform/oracle seeds are therefore reused in all 8 rate cells of a given phi -- the 8 cells within a phi are NOT independent.
ABF arm is identical across all 8 ema dirs and the oracle/uniform baseline dir: max |dFinal L2(F)| = 3.96e-07.
Generating code was NEVER committed (docs/ORPHAN_ARTIFACT_PROVENANCE.md). Method labels are inferred from filenames. UNVERIFIED -- do not cite.

fr_estimated_condrefresh and fr_estimated_estrefresh are excluded from the target-ablation contrasts: they are not members of {estimated,uniform,oracle} and their mechanism is unverified (estrefresh was additionally built from a different code version -- missing none__F_moment).

pilot_20260616_225737 and pilot_20260617_001656 share bit-identical ABF runs (max |d final L2(F)| = 1.45e-07 over 200 matched seeds) but their FR arms differ. Pilots are kept as SEPARATE cells and must not be pooled or double counted.
stage=='main' only. Stages difficulty_budget / difficulty_crowding / difficulty_replicas / failure / pilot / stage0_reproduce carry ONLY abf + fr_estimated -> excluded.

stage main carries fr_estimated at fr_rate in {0.05,0.10,0.20,0.50} under one method label. Only fr_rate==0.10 matches fr_uniform / fr_oracle; the other three rate arms (fr_est_gentle / _strong / _aggressive) are EXCLUDED. Pooling them would average gentle with aggressive.
pilot stage has NO fr_oracle arm (abf + fr_estimated + fr_uniform only) -> only the est-vs-uni contrast is computable; cells classify as U.
fr_estimated_adaptive is present at 10 seeds per cell but is a different METHOD (online-gated adaptive rate), not a target variant; excluded from the three target contrasts.

pentane p1 cells carry TWO arms under method=='fr_estimated': name=='fr_estimated' (fr_rate=0.02, matched to uniform/oracle) and name=='fr_active' (fr_rate=0.20). Only name=='fr_estimated' is used. opes arms excluded.
stage 'tuning' has only abf + fr_r0.02..0.40 + opes (no uniform/oracle) -> excluded.

stage=='production' only (tuning / runlength / opes_tuning have no uniform/oracle). Within it, name=='fr_active' (fr_rate=0.2) and opes are excluded; only the matched name=='fr_estimated' arm is used.
2-D torsion-torus cells have abf + fr_estimated + fr_active + opes only -- no uniform/oracle arm.
screen/resgate stages are ABF-only.
